findings.title: Login SQL Injection
findings.description: Raw SQL login query allows authentication bypass.

findings.title: Search SQL Injection
findings.description: Search input is concatenated into a raw SQL query.

findings.title: Stored and Reflected XSS
findings.description: Untrusted post, comment, and search values are rendered with escaping disabled.

findings.title: Private Post IDOR
findings.description: A logged-in user can read another user's private post by changing the ID.

findings.title: Missing Admin Role Check
findings.description: Any authenticated user can access administrator pages.

findings.title: Unauthorized Post Deletion
findings.description: Any authenticated user can delete another user's post.

findings.title: Unrestricted File Upload
findings.description: Extension, MIME type, and file size validation are missing.

findings.title: Authentication Failure Controls Missing
findings.description: Weak passwords, unlimited retries, and no account lockout are allowed.

findings.title: Security Events Not Recorded
findings.description: Attack attempts do not produce security events or alerts.

findings.title: Detailed Error Information Exposure
findings.description: Exception, SQL, and internal path details are returned to users.

findings.title: Security Headers Missing
findings.description: CSP, X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options are not configured.
